cover: What a staging environment is, and why you need one

slides.title: A private copy of your live app
slides.body: Staging matches production as closely as you can afford. Every change runs there first, where only your team can see it.

slides.title: A laptop is a poor guide to production
slides.body: Different database, settings that exist nowhere else, mocked integrations. Staging closes most of that gap.

slides.title: Ten minutes, or an apology
slides.body: A reminder feature that sends every text twice is a quick fix on staging. In production, every patient gets it.

slides.title: Where non-technical people sign off
slides.body: Your operations lead clicks through the new flow before it's live, instead of finding out on Monday.

slides.title: Ask your developer
slides.body: Where do changes go before customers see them? How close is it to production? When did we last test a rollback?
